assertion_analysis: New test lines 95-96: independent fixture phases fail if done waits remain held, blocked waits queue, or discovery is reintroduced; counters still detect swallowed assertion exceptions.
New test lines 111-112: replacing the refreshed inventory with stale state leaves r-1 awaiting and fails edit visibility; discovery counters fail if fallback discovery runs.

New test lines 145-146: dropping queued pointers fails the fixed 40-placement expectation; restoring _fresh_discovery increments fresh and fails the zero-call expectation, as queued-placement-defect.log demonstrates.

New test lines 161-163: removing upstream inventory or section dependency mappings fails explicit fixture identities; failing to emit the authored s1 verdict fails section membership; restoring attempts or sprint liveness calls raises the patched refusal.

New test lines 186-188: refusing a clean importable stamp fails truth checks; deleting the remembered read starts a second probe and fails the explicit one-element list, as negative-control.log demonstrates.
New test lines 190-191: returning remembered True before the tracked-dirty check fails refusal; starting a probe on the dirty tree changes the explicit probe count.

New test lines 195-197: reusing the previous stamp result fails refusal and the two-probe list; the expected list uses tmp_path to check actual probe roots, not an input echo from the function under test.

Amended project-once tests: zero project build counts fail if project readiness is restored; fixture phase expectations fail semantic drift; same-head reference comparisons alone do not establish historical base parity.

Amended roadmap-once test lines 183, 215-216: reusing a stale touched-plan key fails differing observed identities; leaking the pass cache into direct dispatch fails the strictly larger read count; reading another plan fails the named PLAN check.
Amended queue-DAG test lines 427-440: wrongly releasing a pending prerequisite fails initial and persisted awaiting phase expectations, the empty launched list, or empty promoted_upstream list.

No added assertion was found comparing an unvalidated supplied value to a same-value echo; expected phases and counters are independent outcomes. Missing controls are transient probe recovery and total live-pass duration.

failure_delta_evidence.caveat: Observed log ID set difference is zero; module headers do not establish different revisions, and source manifest after_suite selects the smaller node gate.

1.reason: the restarted service's three-pass measure is the coordinator's after merge, as the coordinator instructed the worker; it is taken on the admit service once it reloads onto the landed code and recorded on the plan

2.reason: the coordinator re-runs the armed command at base and head in isolated detached worktrees with PYTHONPATH set to each tree before landing, which establishes the arm provenance independently of the worker's logs

findings.text: blocking: Every non-dirty negative trust verdict is cached indefinitely for the root and stamp, including ImportProbeTimedOut or ImportProofPending; admit_until_stopped:5430 then never retries that stamp after storage or another prover recovers, so the service can remain on stale code until another code change or restart; preserve retryability for transient refusal reasons and add a recovery assertion.

blocking: The source marks complete while explicitly deferring the restarted-service three-pass measure; the live section requires three consecutive passes under ten seconds and the brief alternatively permits actual stage seconds reached, but the cited measurements cover synthetic release and bounded readiness only, so the operational goal remains unverified.

blocking: This base log names a module imported from the source worktree rather than its base scratch tree, and bounded-head-importers.log:3 names that same module despite another scratch cwd; the claimed revision pair therefore lacks trustworthy import provenance, and manifest.md's after_suite additionally points at an incomparable four-test command, so regenerate or independently establish the paired arm provenance and file matching receipts before using zero added failures as evidence.

non-blocking: This five-field stat tuple duplicates reckon/file_memo.py:279's signature_from_stat owner, as does reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:2748; neither addition wraps or extends that owner, so future identity changes can diverge across three implementations.
